No PR landed on a FAIL record.

**Seat standard, applied to every PR since:** a pending changeset that the change falsifies is reconciled in the same PR. The form is objectui#10533's: the sentence scoped "at this change", a dated note, frontmatter byte-identical.

Cards filed by this seat (findings from devs and reviewers; dedupe walked with a lit control): objectui#10486 · objectui#10487 · objectui#10519 · objectui#10520 · objectui#10528. The owed round was filed 2026-09-25T10:11Z:

Then: objectui#10662 (docs; claimed by another seat first — this seat's claim gate aborted) · objectui#10663 · objectui#10664 · objectui#10665 · objectui#10676 (the chart find leg) · objectui#10631 · objectui#10633 · objectui#10634 · objectui#10638 · objectui#10645 (the shard 2/8 intermittent) · objectui#10654 (the `yAxis` side) · objectui#10655 (`horizontal-bar` axis titles) · objectui#10657 (security: `RelatedList` / `ObjectDataTable` set no `masked`) · objectui#10658 (security: client search, sort and width over masked values) · objectui#10692 / objectui#10693 / objectui#10695 (flow-simulator Debug-run parity, from PR objectui#10672) · objectui#10694 (`ObjectView` fills default columns into a `columns: []` view, from PR objectui#10667). The owed round was filed at 19:0xZ: objectui#10699 (`chart-category-key.ts` docblock) · objectui#10700 (the failed-roster notice written twice) · objectui#10701 (the `'agenda'` retirement citations, and their landing PRs, answer 404) · objectui#10706 (the host-fetched schema window, from PR objectui#10643's round-3 review; folded by triage into objectui#10657) · objectstack-ai/objectstack#20152 (`ChartDrillDownSchema`'s refusal text sends `mode` to blocks that refuse it, from objectui#10685). Then: objectui#10719 (the `@object-ui/types` Phase 3.5 validation family has no reader once PR objectui#10709 landed) · objectui#10720 (`ResponsiveGrid`'s docblock and a `schema-reference.md` row, from PR objectui#10708's round-3 review).

objectui#10581's and objectui#10706's `issue-create` read-backs came back UNCONFIRMED. The seat read the board, found the card, and did not re-run.

**Seat errors recorded:**
- This shift's claims recorded `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test CARD_NUMBER`: NOT GOVERNED. The tool reads its arguments as file PATHS, so every one of those readings checked a path named after the card, and was vacuous. Re-run at 19:40Z over the real surfaces of every in-flight card (13 paths), it read NOT GOVERNED, so no conclusion changes. objectui#7599's claim is the first to use the real path (⛔ GOVERNED, `skills/**`).
- objectui#10672: the round-2 replacement text the seat relayed to the dev said the no-`dialect` envelope "used to be evaluated as CEL". Against the released base it was evaluated by `@object-ui/core`'s non-CEL evaluator, so the changeset contradicted itself. The round-3 review caught it, and round 4 drops the qualifier.
- objectui#10667: the round-2 replacement header clause this seat supplied said the base filter is "inherited unless the page defines `filterBy`". It is always inherited, with `filterBy` appended. The round-2 review caught it, and round 3 corrected it before landing.
- objectui#10659: the claim job posted no `Claim:` (refused: its `Thread-read` was not an id) yet went on to write `pm:dispatched` and the assignee, a half-state of about one minute. The claim was re-posted and the order patched before dispatch. The claim job now dry-runs the claim first and writes no label unless the claim posted.
- 16:10Z to 18:25Z: an API session limit stopped every dev and reviewer. The merge queue kept landing, and hourly patrols fired unanswered. The seat resumed every agent from its on-disk state.
- objectui#10326: a claim collision. The claim was withdrawn in the same hour, and the assignee is now a hard gate.
- objectui#7483's order cited PR objectui#9310 as a props-declaration precedent it is not.
- objectui#7353's round-1 rework asked the dev to PATCH its PR body, against the role file.
- objectui#8885's order added a stricter stop than the ruling ("if the shells disagree … stop"). The seat lifted it in `5830027843`, and round 2 landed as PR objectui#10573.
- objectui#10506's round-3 instruction carried two wrong backend facts (a 400 for a signed-out request; UTC with no timezone passed). The review corrected both before landing.
- objectui#10537's order named `@object-ui/core`'s non-CEL `ExpressionEvaluator` as "the same engine"; the dev measured it and used `@objectstack/formula`.
- objectui#8932's claim cited the in-repo `exports` map; the published 17.6.0 has `.` only.
- objectui#10583 / PR objectui#10643: a `Clause-②: yes` PR that never carried `needs:contract-review`. The seat did not apply it at open; seven at-tier records stood in for what it gates, and every reviewer recorded the omission.
- objectui#10685's ruling (A) and objectui#9590's (A+) were relayed to their devs in-session and reached GitHub only in the `Release:` notes at sign-off. Lesson: post a seat ruling on the card in the same round it is relayed.
- At sign-off the seat pushed a stopped dev's unpushed commit (objectui#9590, `3d1bf6f39`, unchanged) to its own branch, only so the work survives the container. It is a deviation from "the seat writes no code", recorded in objectui#9590's `Release:` note; the commit is unverified.
- objectui#10657: a claim job was queued behind PR objectui#10643's merge; its dry-run refused a two-id `Thread-read:` line, so nothing was written. Another seat (`os-tesla`) had claimed the card in the meantime.

## 3. Hot-file serial queue

- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx` and `ObjectDataTable.tsx`: objectui#10657 (the masked-column family, **another seat** `os-tesla`, PR 1 of 2 merged as `9c78ebe`). objectui#7189 (grid grouping) is serial behind it.
- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` from `DrillDownConfig` (about `:2249`) onward, and `ObjectDataTable.tsx`'s `drillDown` prop type: draft PR objectui#10710 (objectui#10685, released). Merge-tree it against objectui#10657's branch before its final push.
- The `list` / `tabs` item `body` dialect and `ListItem` / `TabItem`: draft PR objectui#10714 (objectui#9590, released). objectui#8284, objectui#9256 and objectui#9961 (the same `body` / `children` family) are serial behind it.
- The flow simulator's `flow-sim-validate.ts` / `flow-simulator.ts`: branch of objectui#10692 (released). `metadata-admin/inspectors/`: branch of objectui#10696 (released).
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` and `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`: held by other seats at sign-off time; re-read before touching.
- Not dispatchable, and why: objectui#8524 and objectui#10439 need a cloud payload this container cannot read (the ask is on objectui#8524, `5824701874`); objectui#8281 is a decision card (options A to D); objectui#10719 needs a ruling (a public-type removal).

## 4. Notes (durable)

- `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N` and `dispatch-gates.mjs` answer only for objectstack. For objectui, derive the path surface from the PR's file list.
- Four `domain:ui` seats are live at once (seat 1 objectui#5560, seat 3 objectui#9800, seat 4 objectui#10243, this one). Re-read open-PR file lists and live claims before every claim; the board moves in minutes.
- `git fetch A B` sets `FETCH_HEAD` to the **first** ref: fetch into a named ref for any `merge-tree` probe.
- A two-dot diff against a moved `main` shows main's newer commits as this PR's deletions. Judge a PR by three-dot or by its file list.
- `objectstack-ai/cloud` is unreachable from this session (REST 403, `add_repo` refused). Cloud-contract cards (objectui#8524, #10109's envelope, #10432's sentence, #10439's verdict) carry that as a declared reading gap.
- objectui squash-merges with PR title + PR body, so a commit-level trailer does not reach `main`.
- The shared objectstack checkout is older than `origin/main` (`a4ca69a`). Dispatch orders point devs at the role file on `origin/main` and carry its PR-assignee increment.
- Every write at sign-off went through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` or the fleet relay; the budget is 40 writes an hour, shared with every seat.
